_doc: Pinned integrity baseline for the FROZEN certifier core. The audit harness (and the in-repo verify_frozen_core() check) compares the live sha256 of each file against these REAL constants and fails on ANY difference. Replaces the previous 'undefined' baseline, which made the read-only hash check unprovable. These files are the root of trust: vectorforge/science.py is the frozen certifier (Clopper-Pearson / bootstrap lower bounds, leakage auditor, stratified split, calibration) and vfplatform/sealed.py is the counted-peek + metric-routing guard in front of it. They MUST NOT change outside an explicit, reviewed re-freeze; if either legitimately changes, recompute and re-pin here in the same commit and explain why in the commit message.
